unmodeled.text: When attacking an enemy with Skill 1: Remove status effects applied to enemy that buff their target for a certain period of time. When this Trait activates, it also nullifies status effects applied to the enemy. Does not apply to invincibility. and Increase the cooldown time of the enemy's dodging by 100%.
When dealing damage with Hit 3 of a Normal Attack, 100% chance to: Remove enemy's ATK increase.
Recover 3% of HP 2 time(s) when enough damage is taken to KO character.
When attacking an Attacker(s): Increase Normal Attack damage dealt by 50%. and Reduce the cooldown time of Skill 1 by 3%.
When your HP is 50% or less: Boost the cooldown reduction speed of dodge by 50%.
When a damage-dealing Stun infliction has been nullified: Increase the cooldown time of the enemy's skill by 50%. and ATK: Boosted by 30% for 10 second(s). (Cannot Stack)
When hit with Knockback by enemy: Reduce the cooldown time of Skill 1 by 30%.

limitations: Pesos e fatores são heurísticos, não oficiais nem medidos em partidas.
Não simula dano final, evolução de skills, mapas, inimigos, troca de classe ou todos os traits.
Traits adicionais não estão equipados neste ranking. Recomendações de atributos são separadas.
Condições usam os fatores gerais 0,5 e 0,25; o cenário real pode mudar a ordem.
Os cinco sets podem compartilhar medalhas: não se força diversidade à custa da pontuação.
